tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.title: List case studies
tools.description: List Ivan de Murard's published product case studies (Sonor, Aetherix, Tacet, Lore, Anima) with slug, tagline, label and URL. Use get_case_study to fetch the full narrative for one of them.

tools.name: get_case_study
tools.title: Get case study
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown narrative for one case study by slug. Slugs: 'sonor', 'aetherix', 'tacet', 'lore', 'anima'. Content covers vision, architecture, stack and outcomes.

slug.description: Case study slug: sonor, aetherix, tacet, lore, or anima.

tools.name: get_about
tools.title: Get about & contact
tools.description: Return Ivan de Murard's professional bio: focus, track record, current builds and contact links (email, schedule, LinkedIn, GitHub, X).

tools.name: list_journal_entries
tools.title: List Field Notes
tools.description: List Ivan de Murard's Field Notes (journal) entries with slug, title, date, category and excerpt. Use get_journal_entry with a slug from this list to read the full body.

tools.name: get_journal_entry
tools.title: Get Field Note
tools.description: Fetch one Field Notes entry in full by slug: title, subtitle, date, category and the complete body rendered as readable Markdown. Use list_journal_entries to discover valid slugs.

slug.description: Field Note slug, as returned by list_journal_entries.
